description.value: Multitask pretraining of DPA-3.1-3M on the OpenLAM-v1 dataset collection using dataset encoding for multi-task training across 31 diverse datasets. Training performed for 4 million steps on 128 GPUs with Adam optimizer, exponential learning rate scheduling from 1e-3 to 1e-6, and MSE loss function.
description.evidence: PDF Section 2.5 and Table S-9 provide details on the training procedure, optimizer, loss function, and hyperparameters.

description.value: Scaling law investigation of DPA3 models on the OMat24 dataset. Training experiments conducted with varying model sizes (L3, L6, L9, L16, 24) under six fixed IsoFLOP settings to demonstrate power-law scaling of validation energy MAE with model parameters, dataset size, and compute budget.
description.evidence: PDF Section 2.4 and Fig. 4 describe the scaling law experiments and results.
